behavior_case.title: Release a pharmaceutical shipment only with typed batch, certificate, release, temperature, customs, and dispatch review evidence
behavior_case.summary: The reviewed shipment is dispatchable only inside the finite accepted scenario; the blocked shipment remains visibly incomplete.

notes: The dispatch review cites a context-indexed ShipmentContainsBatch relation fact and a reviewer constrained to a finite refinement.

when.label: Trace the released shipment through its contained batch to the reviewed certificate of analysis

expected_outcomes: The bounded path query returns exactly CoA_RX_42 for Shipment_RX_1007.
Shipment_RX_1008 is not silently treated as certified or released.
The generated receipt cites the regulated-shipment rules and implementation surface.
notes: Strong means exact finite query completeness only after VerifyMain accepts query_result_v4; it does not mean regulatory or open-world completeness.
Implementation mapping and code generation stay in the tooling overlay.
